en: A cause that is a non-arisen state is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither a cause nor non-arisen. [There are] nine [ways] in the case of the object; nine in the case of predominance and decisive support.

A cause that is a state destined to arise is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither a cause nor destined to arise. [There are] nine [ways] in the case of the object; nine in the case of predominance and decisive support.
